body:
The Los Angeles Department of Water and Power Employees Retirement Plan (LADWP) has committed $250 million to real estate funds, including funds managed by The Vistria Group, Locust Point Capital and DRA Advisors.

Vistria Housing Fund, an open-end, core-plus, value-added fund, received $100 million for its strategy investing in workforce housing in the United States.

Locust Point Private Credit Fund IV received $75 million as a closed-end, value-added fund that provides owner-operators of the senior housing and care sector with subordinate debt, preferred equity and opportunistic senior mortgage loans. The Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois committed $100 million to this fund earlier in 2026.

Locust Point Private Credit Fund III, its predecessor, closed with $668 million in total capital.

DRA Growth and Income Fund XII received $75 million.

p: Los Angeles Department of Water and Power Employees Retirement Plan (LADWP)은 The Vistria Group, Locust Point Capital, DRA Advisors가 운용하는 펀드를 포함하여 부동산 펀드에 2억 5000만 달러를 출자 약정했다.
개방형 core-plus, value-added 펀드인 Vistria Housing Fund는 미국 내 근로자 주거용 부동산(workforce housing) 투자 전략을 위해 1억 달러를 받았다.

Locust Point Private Credit Fund IV는 시니어 하우징 및 〮케어 섹터의 소유주-운영사(owner-operator)에게 후순위채, 상환전환우선주(preferred equity), 기회추구형 시니어 담보대출을 제공하는 폐쇄형 value-added 펀드로 75만 달러를 받았다. The Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois는 2026년 초 이 펀드에 1억 달러를 출자 약정했다.
전작인 Locust Point Private Credit Fund III는 총 6억 6800만 달러의 자금으로 펀드레이징을 마감했다.
DRA Growth and Income Fund XII는 7500만 달러를 받았다.
